title: Easier access to rotate graphics tablet by adding an Plasmoid and shortcuts
line: Two new global shortcuts, Rotate Drawing Tablet Clockwise and Counterclockwise, turn the tablet by 90° and show an OSD with the new orientation.
explanation: A drawing tablet's orientation could only be changed from the Orientation combo box in System Settings > Drawing Tablet, so switching between landscape and portrait meant opening that page every time; there was no shortcut, OSD or widget for it. A new KWin plugin (like the existing touchpad shortcuts plugin) registers two global actions with no default keys, which rotate every tablet tool that supports orientation by 90° through the same LibInput::Device::setOrientation() the settings page uses (so it is saved to kcminputrc), then show a plasmashell OSD naming the new orientation.

commits.message:
plugins: add global shortcuts to rotate drawing tablets

Changing a drawing tablet's orientation meant opening the Drawing Tablet
settings page every time. This adds a plugin with two global shortcuts,
with no default keys, that rotate every tablet by 90° and show an OSD.

BUG: 431499

From fa76a985e122f3c1333134a1c686c124768cf862 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001

diff --git a/src/plugins/tabletshortcuts/tabletshortcuts.cpp b/src/plugins/tabletshortcuts/tabletshortcuts.cpp

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/plugins/tabletshortcuts/tabletshortcuts.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL
+*/
+
+#include "tabletshortcuts.h"
+
+#include "backends/libinput/device.h"
+#include "input.h"
+
+#include <KGlobalAccel>
+#include <KLocalizedString>
+
+#include <QAction>
+#include <QDBusConnection>
+#include <QDBusMessage>
+#include <QDBusPendingCall>
+
+namespace KWin
+{
+
+// Clockwise order, matching the rotations applied by LibInput::Device
+static const Qt::ScreenOrientation s_orientations[] = {
+    Qt::PrimaryOrientation,
+    Qt::PortraitOrientation,
+    Qt::InvertedLandscapeOrientation,
+    Qt::InvertedPortraitOrientation,
+};
+
+static QString orientationName(Qt::ScreenOrientation orientation)
+{
+    switch (orientation) {
+    case Qt::PortraitOrientation:
+        return i18nc("@info:OSD drawing tablet orientation", "Portrait");
+    case Qt::InvertedLandscapeOrientation:
+        return i18nc("@info:OSD drawing tablet orientation", "Inverted Landscape");
+    case Qt::InvertedPortraitOrientation:
+        return i18nc("@info:OSD drawing tablet orientation", "Inverted Portrait");
+    default:
+        return i18nc("@info:OSD drawing tablet orientation", "Landscape");
+    }
+}
+
+TabletShortcuts::TabletShortcuts()
+{
+    QAction *clockwiseAction = new QAction(this);
+    clockwiseAction->setProperty("componentName", QStringLiteral("kwin"));
+    clockwiseAction->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("Rotate Tablet Clockwise"));
+    clockwiseAction->setText(i18nc("@action:inmenu", "Rotate Drawing Tablet Clockwise"));
+    KGlobalAccel::setGlobalShortcut(clockwiseAction, QList<QKeySequence>());
+    connect(clockwiseAction, &QAction::triggered, this, [this]() {
+        rotate(true);
+    });
+
+    QAction *counterclockwiseAction = new QAction(this);
+    counterclockwiseAction->setProperty("componentName", QStringLiteral("kwin"));
+    counterclockwiseAction->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("Rotate Tablet Counterclockwise"));
+    counterclockwiseAction->setText(i18nc("@action:inmenu", "Rotate Drawing Tablet Counterclockwise"));
+    KGlobalAccel::setGlobalShortcut(counterclockwiseAction, QList<QKeySequence>());
+    connect(counterclockwiseAction, &QAction::triggered, this, [this]() {
+        rotate(false);
+    });
+}
+
+void TabletShortcuts::rotate(bool clockwise)
+{
+    std::optional<Qt::ScreenOrientation> newOrientation;
+    const auto devices = input()->devices();
+    for (InputDevice *inputDevice : devices) {
+        auto device = qobject_cast<LibInput::Device *>(inputDevice);
+        if (!device || !device->isTabletTool() || !device->supportsCalibrationMatrix()) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const auto current = std::ranges::find(s_orientations, device->orientation());
+        const int index = current == std::end(s_orientations) ? 0 : std::distance(std::begin(s_orientations), current);
+        const int count = std::size(s_orientations);
+        const Qt::ScreenOrientation orientation = s_orientations[(index + (clockwise ? 1 : count - 1)) % count];
+        device->setOrientation(orientation);
+        if (!newOrientation) {
+            newOrientation = orientation;
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (newOrientation) {
+        QDBusMessage message = QDBusMessage::createMethodCall(QStringLiteral("org.kde.plasmashell"),
+                                                              QStringLiteral("/org/kde/osdService"),
+                                                              QStringLiteral("org.kde.osdService"),
+                                                              QStringLiteral("showText"));
+        message.setArguments({QStringLiteral("input-tablet"), i18nc("@info:OSD", "Drawing tablet orientation: %1", orientationName(*newOrientation))});
+        QDBusConnection::sessionBus().asyncCall(message);
+    }
+}
+
+}
+
+#include "moc_tabletshortcuts.cpp"

+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL

+class TabletShortcuts : public KWin::Plugin
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+
+public:
+    explicit TabletShortcuts();
+
+private:
+    void rotate(bool clockwise);
+};
+
+}

media.caption: Shortcuts > Window Management on master: no action to rotate a drawing tablet (list goes Restore Window → Setup Window Shortcut)
With the change: Rotate Drawing Tablet Clockwise and Rotate Drawing Tablet Counterclockwise, assignable like any other shortcut
Today the only way to rotate the tablet is the Orientation combo box in System Settings > Drawing Tablet
Pressing the shortcut rotates the tablet and shows an OSD: 'Drawing tablet orientation: Portrait'
The rotation is saved: the Drawing Tablet page opened afterwards shows Orientation: Portrait
